//: Story Phase 13: the Build-Your-Own Stenchmaster Entertainment System Kit (ages eight and up), built on the barrel table in the old quarters out of the kit, three of Jim's forks, a horseshoe, a copper coil and a transformer. It shares the Mark II's dials (the two sets are connected by a cable that goes the long way round, via cardboard Brogath, the deck and a cannon) and its sauce-can aerial. It came with a smell vent nobody asked for: Stench-O-Vision. Like every set on this ship, it is impossible, and nobody opens it.

ses_kit.name: The Build-Your-Own S.E.S. (bedroom edition)
offComments: captain: Off. The little grille on the side is still warm.
garrick[proud]: It's thinking about smells, Captain.
captain: A miniature television on a barrel. Forks on top. A horseshoe on the forks.

channels.title: The Frog Tax Man
channels.//: Story Phase 14: with the fine-tuning wheel off (Brogath took it off), the bedroom set finds channel 7 for the first time.
comments: captain: The Frog Tax Man. The most boring programme on the ship.
brogath[pleased]: (from the floor) He's very brave.

channels.title: The Stenchmaster Channel
comments: garrick[delighted]: Twenty-four hours, Captain. It says so in the corner.
captain: ...Is it still going? The Disaster?

wiring: captain: The back. INSERT ANTENNA HERE (FORKS NOT INCLUDED). Three of Jim's forks.
powerSource: captain: The transformer from under the Mark II's crate. It hums. Everything in this room hums now.

no_signal.//: Built, no aerial: snow whatever the channel, until the cable reaches the Mark II.
lookComments: captain: Snow. It needs the aerial. The aerial's in the galley.
garrick[businesslike]: Cable, Captain. A LONG one.

sash_ad.//: Story Phase 14 (chapter 162): the Bling Bling King's commercial, on every channel at once.
lookComments: captain: Sashes. On every channel. Fluttering.

vent.//: Story Phase 13 (chapter 136): Stench-O-Vision. The knobs on the side of the bedroom set. Every wrong one does something to the picture or the smell; after three tries the VENT SHUT lever turns up behind the horseshoe, and it works. Choose which to try first; no wrong answer is a dead end. The programme carries on throughout, and keeps puffing until the vent is shut.
openLines: captain: Knobs. MORE, NOSE, PINE?, UPSIDE. Nothing that says SHUT.
garrick[proud]: It's a very immersive kit, Captain.

list.label: MORE
lines: phhhHHHHHH. The grille breathes harder. The smell of the programme gets more programme.
bob[disgusted]: It's ONIONS. It's FULL onions.
MORE again. The onion goes past onion into something else.
pete[annoyed]: STOP TURNING THAT ONE!

list.label: NOSE
lines: For a second: a test card. A big painted nose, and the words SMELL TEST. Then back to the programme.
ned: It's testing US.

list.label: PINE?
lines: The picture goes purple. The smell does not go pine. It goes onion, with a hint of pine.
jim[disgusted]: That's worse. Pine makes it WORSE.
Green. Onion, with a hint of green.
Back to normal colours. Normal onion.

list.label: UPSIDE
lines: The picture turns upside down. The smell, somehow, also smells upside down.
gristle: How does a smell go upside down?
Right way up. The smell rights itself too.

list.label: VENT SHUT
lines: Behind the horseshoe, a little brass lever you hadn't seen: VENT SHUT.
doneLines: CLICK. The grille closes. The picture stays. The smell stops coming.

advert.//: Story Phase 14 (chapter 162): getting rid of the commercial. Nothing works the way it should: OFF shrinks it and brings it back; pulling the plug changes nothing; taking a valve out SHARPENS the picture; the smell knob gives you the smell of fresh linen, fluttering; every channel has the same advert. After three tries the panel tunes to the Frog Tax Man, and the advert's still there.
openLines: captain: Knobs. OFF. A plug. Valves. The smell knob. Channel.

list.label: OFF
lines: The picture folds to a dot. Thinks about it. Comes back. Sashes.
bob: It's not OFF.

list.label: PULL THE PLUG
lines: You pull the plug out of the wall. You hold it up. The set doesn't notice.
gristle: It's not plugged in. It's STILL ON.

list.label: TAKE A VALVE OUT
lines: You pull out a valve, hot, glowing. The picture gets SHARPER. You can see every thread of the sash.
pete: You've made it BETTER?

list.label: SMELL
lines: The vent puffs. A smell of fresh linen. FLUTTERING linen, somehow. You can smell it flapping.
jim: How does a SMELL flutter?

list.label: CHANNEL
lines: Channel.
doneLines: Channel seven. The Frog Tax Man's channel. And on it: a sash. Fluttering. Six of them now.
